source_checks.finding: The explicit-build overload constructs UnrealPackage, assigns package.BuildTarget = buildTarget, then calls package.Deserialize(stream).

Hawken has Build(860,860,2,4) and no adjacent OverridePackageVersionAttribute. GameBuild(BuildName) chooses the named enum field last BuildAttribute and copies generation/flags; it does not verify the package summary. FindBuildInfo only scans and applies BuildAttribute.Verify when BuildTarget is Unset; for a specified non-Unknown target it returns the enum field by name. The BuildTarget setter assigns a non-null GameBuild. SetupBuild build autodetection runs only when package.Build is null, so it does not select a different build from the 892/9 summary.
ScriptText is conditional on !Package.IsConsoleCooked() and UE4Version <117; this platform-sensitive serialization branch is separate from BuildName selection.
UField.Next is read after UObject base deserialization.
UFunction calls base deserialization before reading its function-specific tail.
Non-class exports deserialize their default-property list after the base fields; class exports (ClassIndex==0) return before this list.
A default-property tag begins with a NameReference; None terminates the property list.

resolved.claim: For the retained HawkenGame export procedure, UELib is explicitly given BuildName.Hawken before package deserialization; it does not auto-detect a build from the package 892/9 version fields.
basis: Both retained export helpers call LoadPackage with BuildName.Hawken.
The setter instantiates GameBuild(Hawken); FindBuildInfo takes the explicit-name path and skips BuildAttribute.Verify.
SetupBuild build auto-detect clause is guarded by Build==null, which is false after the setter.
resolved.confidence: Confirmed for the retained helper/source path, not a claim about all parser invocations.

prior_layout_label_erratum.corrected_label: Empty UObject default-property list terminator: FName None (name index 14240 for Engine headers; 22803 for HawkenGame header, number 0).
basis: The retained headers carry those exact FName values.
UObject.DeserializeProperties reads property tags for non-class exports.
UDefaultProperty reads a NameReference and returns at None.
UClass exports skip default properties, but UFunction exports have nonzero ClassIndex and include the terminator.
prior_layout_label_erratum.layout_effect: The 8 bytes are not UObject.Name. Their interpretation as the None-terminated default-property list accounts for the two-word span before UField.Next; retain the existing byte offsets but correct the field label.

remaining_limits: This resolves explicit BuildName selection and the 892/9 auto-detection caveat for the retained export path; it does not attest that a live UELib session ran or that the DLL is reproducible from source.

Platform classification remains separate: IsConsoleCooked depends on package Cooked flag and CookerPlatform==Console. The retained normalized package path and parser source indicate the SetupBuild folder fallback does not match standard CookedPC/CookedPCConsole/CookedPCServer names; no session/config capture was produced, so this supplement does not claim the actual platform state at parse time.

The prior ScriptText/Children conditional-layout conclusion remains conditional on IsConsoleCooked and the package UE4 version. No native runtime, fire invocation, packet bytes/cursor, or gameplay acceptance is established.
conclusion: The selected parser build is no longer uncertain for the retained HawkenGame manifest/export workflow: BuildName.Hawken is explicitly set before deserialize, bypassing version-based auto-detection. The earlier field-layout label at offsets +4/+8 is corrected to the None terminator of a default-property list, not UObject.Name. Platform-sensitive serialization and native/runtime behavior remain outside this evidence.
